deck: WattZap × VVDN — Initial Pilot Requirement Brief
title: Rice Mill Pilot
subtitle: Initial requirement for MVP deployment
a11yLabel: Rice mill pilot: four requirement areas — metering and sensing, connectivity, power environment, and pilot success criteria.

cards.heading: Metering & Sensing
bullets: Three-phase CT metering on mains plus two major motor loads
Power factor and harmonics captured at one-minute intervals
Non-invasive installation during a planned mill halt

cards.heading: Connectivity
bullets: 4G LTE primary link with local buffering through outages
MQTT over TLS into the WattZap data platform
Remote OTA firmware and configuration updates

cards.heading: Power Environment
bullets: 440 V three-phase supply, 75–150 kW connected load
Wide voltage swings and DISCOM outages expected
Surge and dust protection to IP54 or better

cards.heading: Pilot Success Criteria
bullets: Baseline load profile within two weeks of installation
Per-unit savings validated against the DISCOM bill
Device uptime of 99% or higher across the 90-day pilot

content.note: Pilot site: rice mill, Telangana. Working draft — quantities and specs to be confirmed with VVDN.
